blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Virtual footwear try-on (VFTON), a critical yet underexplored area in virtual try-on (VTON), aims to synthesize faithful try-on results given diverse footwear and model images while maintaining 3D consistency and texture authenticity. Unlike conventional garment-focused VTON methods, VFTON presents unique challenges due to (1) Data Scarcity, which arises from the difficulty of perfectly matching product shoes with models wearing the identical ones, (2) Viewpoint Misalignment, where the target foot pose and source shoe views are always misaligned, leading to incomplete texture information and detail distortion, and (3) Background-induced Color Distortion, where complex material of footwear interacts with environmental lighting, causing unintended color contamination. To address these challenges, we introduce MVShoes, a multi-view shoe try-on dataset consisting of 7305 well-annotated image triplets, covering diverse footwear categories and challenging try-on scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a dual-stream DiT architecture, ShoeFit, designed to mitigate viewpoint misalignment through Multi-View Conditioning with 3D Rotary Position Embedding, and alleviate background-induced distortion using the LayeredRefAttention which leverages background features to modulate footwear latents. The proposed framework effectively decouples shoe appearance from environmental interferences while preserving high-quality texture detail through decoupled denoising and conditioning branches. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method substantially improves rendering fidelity and robustness under challenging real-world product shoes, establishing a new benchmark in high-fidelity footwear try-on synthesis.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Virtual Footwear Try-On (VFTON) involves synthesizing product shoes onto human foot images, preserving their geometric structure and material properties, based on input images of both the source product and the target foot. VFTON offers significant commercial potential and academic value, with Nike’s annual footwear sales reaching 33,427 million dollars [ 48 ] , while shoes, as complex 3D multi-view objects [ 57 ] , present unique challenges in research on controllable generation. Unfortunately, this field has not been sufficiently explored within the community.
blocks.zh: Virtual Footwear Try-On (VFTON) 涉及将产品鞋合成到人脚图像上,根据源产品和靶脚的输入图像保留其几何结构和材料属性. VFTON提供了巨大的商业潜力和学术价值,耐克每年的鞋类销售额达到334.27亿美元[48];而鞋作为复杂的3D多景物[57],在可控出产的研究中提出了独特的挑战. 不幸的是,在社区内对这一领域没有进行充分的探讨。

blocks.en:
There are three main challenges hindering the advancement of VFTON. (1) Data Scarcity : Due to the prevalence of footwear with similar appearances but subtle variations, as in Fig. 1 (a-1), such as slight differences in shoelaces, heels, and stripes, it is challenging to accurately match product shoes with models wearing the identical ones. Further exacerbating this issue, companies tend to keep data related to shoe try-ons confidential due to its clear commercial value [ 75 , 22 ] . As a result, there is currently no available open-source dataset for footwear try-ons. (2) Viewpoint Misalignment : Unlike flat-lay 2D garment VTON, where both the target garment and human pose are captured from aligned front-facing perspectives, as in Fig. 1 (a-2), virtual footwear try-on inherently involves mismatched viewpoints between in-shop product images (source view) and target human poses (target view). Specifically, information needed by the target view is often not provided in the given product image due to 3D constraints, creating an information-deficient scenario that results in detail distortion and artifacts [ 42 , 56 ] . (3) Background-induced Color Distortion : Unlike the diffuse reflection properties of knitted fabrics in clothing, which ensure visual color largely remains unaffected by the background, shoes often exhibit complex reflective properties that interact with ambient lighting [ 35 ] , making them more susceptible to visual interference from background colors, as in Fig. 1 (a-3). This interaction between appearance and background leads to color contamination from surroundings and distorted material rendering in synthesized results.
The above issues are first identified and explicitly proposed in this paper, which make it impossible for VFTON to share the same pipeline as VTON, thus presenting VFTON with unique challenges and research value.

blocks.en: To tackle these challenges, we introduce MVShoes, the first multi-view footwear try-on dataset . It comprises 7305 annotated high-resolution image triplets, each containing two product shoe images from different views and a corresponding try-on result, as shown in Fig. 2 (a). The dataset covers a diverse range of shoe categories and try-on scenarios, supported by a comprehensive and rigorous data cleaning pipeline to ensure accurate matching of identical product shoes with their human images.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了MVShoes,这是第一个多景鞋试验数据集。 如图2(a)所示,它包括7305个附加说明的高分辨率图像三进制,每个取自不同观点的两出产品鞋相并有相应的尝试结果。 数据集涵盖各种鞋类和试穿假想方案,辅以全面而严格的数据清理管线,以确保相同产品鞋与人类形象的准确匹配.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, we propose ShoeFit, a customized dual-image-stream DiT [ 51 ] architecture for VFTON, which generates high-fidelity try-on results through decoupled denoising and conditioning branches. ShoeFit is also equipped with two key improvements:
(1) Multi-View Conditioning , incorporating reference concatenation [ 13 ] and corresponding 3D Rotary Position Embedding (3D RoPE). While a single source product view often fails to provide complete shoe texture features required for the target try-on view, the try-on results can significantly benefit from multiple source views, effectively reducing uncertainty in target surface rendering and minimizing texture distortion.
(2) LayeredRefAttention Module . LayeredRefAttention leverages background features to modulate shoe features [ 31 ] , decoupling the intrinsic shoe appearance from the surroundings. Additionally, the subsequent denoising attention suppresses background-related computations, effectively mitigating background color contamination. This layer-aware attention mechanism significantly enhances robustness in real-world footwear try-on scenarios.

(1)多维条件(多维条件),收录了参考协和[13]和相应的3D回转位置嵌入(3D RoPE). 虽然单一源产品视图往往无法提供目标试取视图所需的完整的鞋纹特征,但试取结果可以从多源视图中大大受益,能有效减少目标表面渲染的不确定性并尽量减少纹理扭曲.

我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We formally define the VFTON problem, reporting the unique issues of Data Scarcity, Viewpoint Misalignment and Background-induced color distortion across real-world scenarios. • We curate the first shoe try-on dataset, containing 7305 pairs of high-quality multi-view garment-model samples, paving the way for subsequent footwear try-on studies. • We introduce a dual-stream architecture with Multi-View Conditioning and LayeredRefAttention modules to address the challenges in VFTON. • Both quantitative and qualitative experiments validate the superiority of our approach.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Image-based Virtual Try-on. The virtual try-on task is concerned with synthesizing images of a person donning the designated garment with appropriate fit [ 24 ] , while retaining salient characteristics of the original garment and person, given a pair of images depicting a person and a target garment. To execute this task, numerous works [ 17 , 29 , 36 , 4 , 14 , 23 ] have utilized Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) [ 20 ] with two-stage strategy [ 37 , 19 , 66 ] : (1) warping the clothing to the desired shape [ 8 , 40 ] and (2) fusing the deformed clothing via try-on generator based on GAN. As significant progress in Text-to-Image diffusion models [ 25 , 47 , 28 , 11 ] is witnessed in recent years, some works [ 9 , 21 , 45 , 32 , 38 ] have been motivated to incorporate pre-trained diffusion models [ 55 , 52 ] as priors into virtual try-on task.
Most recently, OOTDiffusion [ 65 ] , IDM [ 12 ] , and MMTryon [ 75 ] achieve garment feature extraction with a parallel U-Net and feed them through self-attention for enhanced integration. CatVTON [ 13 ] concatenates the garment and person images along the spatial dimension and feed them into a single UNet.
Unfortunately, these methods serve for fabric clothing, intrinsically lack support for faithful try-on to 3D multi-view shoes with various materials, exhibiting severe color contamination from the background.
blocks.zh:
基于图像的虚拟 Try-on. 虚拟试穿任务涉及将一个人以适当的相合性[24]来装饰指定服装的图像合成,同时保留了原服装和人物的显著特征,给一对描绘一个人和目标服装的图像. 为了执行这项任务,许多作品[17、29、36、4、14、23]利用了具有两阶段战略[37、19、66]的基因横向网络: (1) 通过基于GAN的试接发电机将服装打成所期望的形状[8,40]和(2)将变形服装引信。 近年来,文本到图像传播模型[25、47、28、11]取得了重大进展,因此,一些作品[9、21、45、32、38]被激励将预先培训的传播模型[55、52]作为前作纳入虚拟试运行任务。
最近,OOTDifusion [65], IDM [12],和MMTryon [75] 实现了服装特征取出与平行的U-Net,并通过增强融合的自意来喂食. CatVTON [13] 将服装和人物图像沿空间维度相接,并被喂入一个单一的UNet.
不幸的是,这些方法用于织物服饰,本质上缺乏对有各种材料的忠实试穿到3D多视图鞋的支持,从背景中显示出了严重的色彩污染.

blocks.en: Controllable Diffusion Models. To attain conditional control in diffusion models, T2I-Adapter [ 46 ] and IP-Adapter [ 69 ] incorporate additional trainable modules to fuse condition features. Additionally, some investigations utilize various prompt engineering techniques [ 39 , 68 , 73 ] and implement cross-attention constraints [ 10 , 64 , 30 , 74 ] to facilitate more controllable generation. Recently, the release of FLUX [ 5 ] and SD3 [ 18 ] has sparked renewed interest in DiT architectures [ 51 ] with subsequent conditional frameworks such as Flux.1 Fill [ 6 ] and Flux.1 Redux [ 7 ] achieving inpainting and object injection capabilities through enhanced encoder designs. However, these methods remain constrained by coarse-grained conditioning mechanisms, which fail to ensure generation fidelity—particularly in VFTON tasks with high geometric variability and stringent fidelity requirements.
blocks.zh: 可控扩散模型. 为了在扩散模型中实现有条件的控制,T2I-Adapter[46]和IP-Adapter[69]在引信条件特性中加入了额外的可训练模块. 此外,一些调查利用各种迅速的工程技术[39、68、73],并实行交叉注意限制[10、64、30、74],以促进更能控制的发电。 最近,FLUX [5]和SD3 [18]的发布引发了人们对DiT架构的重新兴趣 [51] ,并随之有了Flux 1 填充 [6] 和Flux 1 Redux [7] 通过增强的编码器设计实现印花和物体注入能力. 但是,这些方法仍然受到粗糙的调节机制的限制,这种机制未能确保生成忠诚——特别是在VFTON任务中,几何变化很大,而且忠诚要求严格。

blocks.en: 3 MVShoes Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 MVShoes 数据集

blocks.en: We collect the first footwear try-on dataset which contains a total of 7305 annotated high-resolution image triplets, each consisting of two product shoe images from different views, and a corresponding try-on result. The dataset features diverse shoe categories and includes foot-specific pose landmarks and shoes-agnostic masks to facilitate precise alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们收集第一个鞋类试接数据集,包含总共7305个注解高分辨图像三重体,每个三重体由来自不同观点的两个出品鞋相组成,并有一个相应的试接结果. 数据集具有不同的鞋类特征,并包括了脚特异性的地标和鞋不可知口罩来方便精确地对齐.

blocks.en: 3.1 MVShoes Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 MVShoes收藏

blocks.en: All images are sourced from the Internet and include a diverse range of model scenarios such as full-body models, half-body models, foot close-ups, as well as a comprehensive variety of shoe categories, effectively meeting practical application needs. Initially, we collected approximately 25,000 raw shoe product image sets, each consisting of 2 to 5 images per shoe, including standalone product images and images of people wearing the shoes from different perspectives.
blocks.zh: 所有图像都取自于互联网,并包括了全体模型,半体模型,脚特写等多种模式情景,以及多种鞋类,有效满足了实际应用需要. 最初,我们收集了大约25,000个原始鞋类产品图像,每个鞋由2到5个图像组成,包括独立的产品图像和人们从不同角度穿鞋的图像.

blocks.en:
Data Processing. We first employ Qwen-VL [ 3 ] to differentiate between product footwear images (without humans) and try-on images featuring human models. Subsequently, we use the CLIP model [ 53 ] to extract image features and set a similarity threshold to eliminate duplicate images within the same raw image set. Next, we segment the shoe region in each image, match the DINO [ 43 ] features and assess their similarity to filter those data pairs with different footwear colors and styles. This process results in the formation of preliminary human-footwear try-on triplets, followed by manual filtering to eliminate any errors or oversights.
We then remove visually blurred images and compile statistics on shoe categories and try-on scenarios. Finally, following the method proposed in DWPose [ 67 ] and Grounding DINO [ 43 ] , we extract foot poses and shoe-agnostic masks. This process culminates in the creation of high-resolution, category-comprehensive try-on triplets. The data processing pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 2 (b).
blocks.zh:
数据处理. 我们首先使用 Quen-VL [3] 来区分产品鞋类图像(没有人类)和以人类模型为主角的试映图像. 随后,我们使用CLIP模型[53]来取出图像特征并设定了类似阈值来消除同一组原始图像中的重复图像. 接下来,我们在每个图像中划分出鞋区,匹配DINO[43]特征,并评估其相似性来过滤那些具有不同鞋色和样式的数据对. 这一过程导致初步形成人-脚服试入三胞胎,再由人工过滤来消除任何错误或疏忽.
然后,我们删除视觉模糊的图像,汇编关于鞋类和尝试情景的统计数据。 最后,我们遵循DWPose[67]和地平地DINO[43]中提出的方法,提取出脚相和鞋不可知口罩. 这一过程最终形成了高分辨,分类综合的试入三重奏. 图2(b)说明了数据处理程序。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Statistic
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集统计

blocks.en: Rich Scenes. In conventional VTON tasks [ 37 , 15 ] , model images typically consist of full-body or upper-body views. However, given that footwear occupies a relatively small proportion of the body in VFTON tasks, full-body and half-body models are less effective in showcasing shoe details. To address this, we simulate the distribution of footwear model scenes observed on e-commerce platforms and curate 4 model scenarios: top-down foot close-up, horizontal foot close-up, half-body model, and full-body model, as illustrated in Fig. 3 , where horizontal foot close-ups constitute the largest proportion. In such cases, accurate preservation of side details is particularly challenging, especially when compounded by viewpoint misalignment.
blocks.zh: 财克相克. 在常规VTON任务 [37, 15]中,模型图像一般由全身或上体视图组成. 然而,鉴于鞋类在VFTON任务中占据了身体相对较少的比例,全身和半身模型在展示鞋类细节方面效果较差. 为了解决这个问题,我们模拟电子商务平台上观测到的鞋类模型场景的分布,并整理出4个模型场景:自上而下脚特写,横向脚特写,半体模型,和全身模型,如图3所示,横向脚特写占最大比例. 在这种情况下,准确保存侧面细节尤其具有挑战性,特别是如果由于观点不一致而变得更加复杂。

blocks.en: Diverse Footwear Categories. We also prioritize the comprehensiveness of footwear categories. By annotating shoe attributes [ 2 ] , we establish a two-level product category label set and ensure that its distribution aligns with everyday use, as depicted in Fig. 3 . Notably, we observe that environmental lighting often affects the visual appearance of footwear, where reflections introduce background color contamination, particularly in categories such as boots, leather shoes, and high heels.
blocks.zh: 不同鞋类 我们还优先考虑鞋类的全面性。 通过对鞋类属性作注释[2],我们建立了一个两级产品类标签集,并确保其分布与日常使用相匹配,如Fig所描述. 3 (英语). 值得注意的是,我们观察到,环境照明往往会影响鞋类的外观,反射会引入背景颜色污染,特别是在靴子、皮鞋和高跟鞋等类别。

blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: An overview of the ShoeFit is presented in Fig. 4 (b). Given a human image X X and target shoe images C I ( n ) C_{I}^{(n)} , ShoeFit is aimed to generate an authentic try-on image. The backbone of ShoeFit employs the FLUX.1-Lite [ 5 ] , with a customized dual-image-stream architecture in Sec. 4.1 : denoising image stream and a copy of it as as conditioning branch to replace text modality. The features of human images and multi-view shoes are then integrated through Reference Concatenation and LayeredRefAttention modules, which are described in Sec. 4.2 and 4.3 .

blocks.en: The original FLUX [ 5 ] is a text-to-image model composed of a series of stacked MM-DiT blocks. Earlier works [ 60 , 61 ] directly concatenate Image/Text condition tokens with noisy image tokens such as [ X ; C I ; C T ] [X;C_{I};C_{T}] , relying on a single denoising stream to finish condition extraction and denoising, while the other deal with text modality, as shown in Fig. 4 (a). However, for VFTON, the generated try-ons are primarily determined by the given shoe images rather than limited semantic prompts. Thus, we remove the text stream from FLUX, achieving approximately 40% parameter savings, including those for T5 [ 54 ] and CLIP models [ 53 ] . Instead, we replicate a portion of the denoising stream’s architecture and weights to initialize the conditioning image stream, establishing a dual-image-stream framework. This design decouples feature preservation of shoe details from the high-quality generation process, allocating additional effective model capacity to enhance overall fidelity performance compared to direct token concatenation approaches [ 60 , 61 ] .
blocks.zh: 最初的FLUX [5] 是一款由一系列堆叠的MM-DIT块所构成的文本到图像模型. 更早的作品 [60,61] 直接将图像/文本条件的符号与吵闹的图像符号相接而成,如 [X; C I; C T; [X; C_{I}; C_{T}],依靠单一去诺化的流来完成条件提取和去诺化,而另一个处理文本模式,如图4(a)所示. 然而,对于VFTON来说,所生成的尝试主要由给定的鞋相来决定,而不是有限的语义提示. 因此,我们从FLUX中去除文本流,实现约40%的参数节约,包括T5[54]和CLIP模型[53]. 相反,我们复制了部分去诺伊克流的架构和权重来初始化了调节图像流,建立了双相相流框架. 这种设计脱钩的特点是从高质量出产过程中保留鞋类细节,分配出额外的有效模型能力来提高整体忠诚性能,与直接的代号接合方法相比[60,61].

blocks.en: 4.2 Multi-view Conditioning
blocks.zh: 4.2 多视图条件

blocks.en: In VFTON, the information about shoes from the try-on view remains incomplete due to view mismatch and 3D-to-2D projection occlusion [ 63 ] . The inherent misalignment between source product images and target human images leads to unfaithful and physically implausible try-on results. Observing that e-commerce platforms often provide multiple-view product images ( e.g. , front, side, top views), we introduce a multi-view shoe image dataset and propose a multi-view conditional injection mechanism via Reference Concatenation and 3D RoPE. The additional perspectives comprehensively encompass more aspects of the shoe, as illustrated in Fig. 4 (c), significantly reducing uncertainty during generation and delivering high-fidelity and commercially viable synthetic results.
blocks.zh: 在VFTON中,由于视图不匹配和3D至2D投影隔离[63],来自试取视图的鞋子信息仍然不完整. 源产品图像与目标人类图像的内在错位导致不忠和物理上不可信的试取结果. 观察到电子商务平台经常提供多视图产品图像(如:前,侧,上视图),我们引入了多视图鞋像数据集,并通过Reference Concatenation和3D RoPE提出多视图有条件的注入机制. 如图4(c)所示,其他观点全面涵盖了鞋的更多方面,大大减少了生产过程中的不确定性,并提供了高真实性和商业上可行的合成结果。

blocks.en: Reference Concatenation. Inspired by CatVTON [ 13 ] , we adopt a simple yet effective multi-view injection strategy: concatenate multi-view conditioning shoe images along the spatial dimension as: C I c ​ a ​ t = [ C I 1 , C I 2 , … ​ C I N ] ∈ ℝ b × N ⋅ l × c C_{I}^{cat}=[C_{I}^{1},C_{I}^{2},...C_{I}^{N}]\in\mathbb{R}^{b\times N\cdot l\times c} , where b b s the batch size, l l denotes the number of image tokens per conditioning image, and c c is the feature channel. The concatenated multi-view latent C I c ​ a ​ t C_{I}^{cat} is then fed into the conditioning image stream for feature extraction and interaction with the target human image. Concurrently, the denoising stream receives 4 concatenated components with 16 + 16 + 1 + 16 16+16+1+16 channels: the noisy human latents X t X_{t} , the latent shoe-agnostic masked image E ⁡ ( X m ​ a ​ s ​ k ​ e ​ d ) E(X_{masked}) , the resized agnostic mask X m X_{m} , and the foot pose landmarks E ⁡ ( X p ​ o ​ s ​ e ) E(X_{pose}) , where E ⁡ ( ⋅ ) E(\cdot) represents VAE [ 33 ] encoding. The effectiveness of Reference Concatenation stems from the global attention interactions in attention layers. Intuitively, during the attention, each Query patch in the human image accesses and matches the most semantically relevant Key-Value pairs from the full set of concatenated multi-view product features, as illustrated in Fig. 4 (c). As a result, our method ensures consistent alignment between all regions in the target pose and their corresponding details in the product images, thereby achieving high-fidelity virtual try-on.

blocks.zh: 4.3 分层反射 模块

blocks.en: We observe that the appearance of the synthesized shoes is highly susceptible to contamination from the background colors of the conditioning images. This phenomenon arises from the complex reflective material of footwear interacting strongly with environmental lighting, termed Background-induced Color Distortion . Specifically, the issue arises when Query patches from the human image inadvertently match key-value pairs originating from the background regions of the conditioning image, as illustrated in Fig. 4 (d). A naive solution involves masking out background regions during attention, but this would neglect critical illumination cues embedded in the background , which are essential for accurately inferring the shoe’s intrinsic appearance and texture [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们看到被合成的鞋的外观极易被取自取材图像的背景颜色所污染. 这种现象源于鞋类与环境照明强烈互动的复杂反射材料,称为背景引起的色彩扭曲。 具体地说,如图4(d)所示,当从人类图像中查询补丁时,就会出现问题,因为这种补丁无意中匹配了来自条件图像背景区域的密钥-值对. 一个天真的解决办法涉及在关注期间掩盖背景区域,但这会忽略背景中嵌入的关键发光提示,这对于准确推断鞋的内在外观和纹理[35]至关重要.

Implementation Details. We employ the FLUX.1-Lite [ 5 ] as the backbone and customize a dual-image-stream architecture as in Sec. 4.1 . Our experiments are carried out on MVShoes at a resolution of 768 × 768 768\times 768 , with 6305 pairs for training and 1000 pairs for testing.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocols. Following evaluation in prior VTON works [ 45 ] , we measure reconstruction accuracy by LPIPS [ 72 ] , SSIM [ 62 ] and DISTS [ 16 ] in a paired setting given ground truth images, and authenticity of unpaired synthesized images by FID [ 50 ] and KID [ 59 ] without ground truth.
blocks.zh: 评价协议。 在先前的VTON作品[45]中进行评估后,我们对重建的准确性进行了测量,由LPIPS[72],SSIM[62]和DISTS[16]在一对设定中给出地面真实图像,以及由FID[50]和KID[59]在没有地面真实性的情况下合成的无假图像的真实性.

blocks.en: Baselines. As a subtask of inpainting, we first select two widely used inpainting FLUX variants as baselines: FLUX.1-Fill [ 6 ] and FLUX.1-Fill-Redux [ 7 ] . The former involves concatenating product images with human images on the spatial dimension, similar to CatVTON [ 13 ] . The latter enhances the conditioning stream with SigLip [ 70 ] to incorporate product shoe images. Additionally, we compare ShoeFit to two state-of-the-art methods in the VTON field: OOTDiffusion [ 65 ] based on the SDXL [ 52 ] and CatVTON [ 13 ] built upon the FLUX.1-Lite. All models are implemented as originally deployed for single-view product shoe conditional generation. Considering CatVTON’s capability to easily extend to multi-image injection, we further train a version of CatVTON to simultaneously inject two product views, the same as ShoeFit, denoted as CatVTON-FLUX-Lite-2V. Please refer to Appendix for more implementation details.
blocks.zh: 基线。 作为涂装的子任务,我们首先选择两个被广泛使用的涂装FLUX变体作为基线:FLUX.1-Fill [6]和FLUX.1-Fill-Redux [7]. 前者涉及将产品图像与空间维度上的人类图像相接而来,类似于CatVTON [13]. 后者用SigLip[70]来增强调制流,以收录出出品鞋相. 此外,我们比较了ShoeFit和VTON领域两种最先进的方法:以SDXL [52]和以FLUX.1-Lite为基础的CatVTON [13]。 所有型号均按原部署用于单视产品鞋类有条件生成. 考虑到CatVTON容易被扩展至多图像注入的能力,我们进一步训练CatVTON版本同时注入两个产品视图,与ShoeFit相同,表示为CatVTON-FLUX-Lite-2V. 关于更多执行细节,请参见附录。

blocks.en: 5.2 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 定性结果

blocks.en: Fig. 5 provides a qualitative comparison between ShoeFit and the baselines on MVShoes, addressing challenges such as complex structures, background interference, and difficult target poses. For a fair comparison, we report the results of the single-view conditioning version of all methods. Notably, we observe that OOTDiffusion [ 65 ] tends to exhibit extreme color variations, while FLUX.1-Fill-Redux [ 7 ] and FLUX.1-Fill [ 6 ] , possibly affected by the limitation of only LoRA [ 26 ] being trainable (r=64), often produce visually plausible results that do not strictly adhere to the input conditions. In contrast, ShoeFit accurately generates structural details of the shoes (rows 1 and 2), decouples environmental lighting (row 3), avoids background confusion (row 4), and demonstrates robustness to uncommon poses (row 5). Please refer to the Appendix for more results.
blocks.zh: 图5对ShoeFit和MVShoes上的基线进行了定性比较,解决了复杂结构、背景干扰和困难目标构成等挑战。 为了进行公平的比较,我们报告所有方法的单视图调制版本的结果。 值得注意的是,OOTDifmation [65] 往往呈现出极端的颜色变化;而FLUX.1-Fill-Redux [7]和FLUX.1-Fill [6] 可能会受到仅可训练的LORA[26]的限制(r=64)的影响,往往会产生不严格遵守输入条件的明显可信的结果. 相形之下,ShoeFit精确地生成了鞋的结构细节(一和二行),脱钩环境照明(三行),避免了背景混乱(四行),并显示了对不寻常的姿势的强健性(五行). 更多成果请参见附录.

blocks.en: 5.3 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 量化结果

blocks.en: For a fair comparison, we report the results of one/two product view conditioning generation separately in Tab. 1 . FLUX.1-Fill-Redux [ 7 ] and FLUX.1-Fill [ 6 ] achieve the worst FID and DISTS scores, while OOTDiffusion [ 65 ] and CatVTON [ 13 ] show complementary performance in unpaired and paired evaluations. ShoesFit, benefiting from the additional specialized parameters provided by the Dual-image-stream DiT framework and background decoupling enabled by the LayeredRefAttention, significantly surpasses all baselines under both single-view and multi-view conditional generation.
blocks.zh: 为了进行公平比较,我们在Tab中分别报告一、二个产品视图调节生成结果。 1,FLUX.1-Fill-Redux [7]和FLUX.1-Fill[6]取得了最差的FID和DISTS分数,而OOTDifusion [65]和CatVTON [13]则在未标和配对的评价中表现出了互补的性能. 鞋Fit利用了由分层RefAttent所允许的双相流DiT框架提供的额外专门参数和背景脱钩,在单视和多视条件生成下大大超过了所有基线.

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.4 读取研究

blocks.en: To validate our technical contributions, we define a Vanilla Model that uses FLUX.1-Lite as the backbone, deploying both a text-stream and an image-stream as in Fig. 4 (a). Multi-view Conditioning and LayeredRefAttention Module are removed, using only one footwear image as conditioning.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的技术贡献,我们界定了以FLUX.1-Lite为骨干线的 " 香草 " 模型,并像图4(a)中那样,部署文本流和图像流。 多视图条件和分层参考 模块被去除,只使用一个鞋类图像作为条件.

blocks.en: Dual-image-stream DiT Framework. Since the text-stream only provides high-level semantics, its utility is limited in VFTON, which demands high image fidelity. Therefore, we first remove the text-stream and replicate a portion of the denoising stream’s architecture and weights to initialize the conditioning image stream, effectively decoupling the conditional feature extraction from the denoising process, while keeping the Vanilla Model’s other settings unchanged(denoted as “+ D-i-s”). As shown in Tab. 2 and Fig. 6 , the vanilla model often generates artifacts and incorrect structures facing high-frequency textures due to the limitation in effective network capacity and the weakness in coupling of conditional images and noise. This demonstrates that the Dual-image-stream DiT framework plays a fundamental role in enhancing the model’s expressive capabilities.
blocks.zh: 双相相流 (原始内容存档于2018-10-29). DiT Framework. 由于文本流只提供高层次的语义,其实用性在VFTON中受到限制,这需要高度的图像忠诚. 因此,我们首先去掉文本流并复制去诺音流的一部分架构和权重来初始化调节图像流,有效地将有条件的特性取自去诺音过程,同时保持"香草模型"的其他设置不变(被指为"+ D-i-s"). 如Tab. 2和Fig. 6所显示,香草模型由于有效网络容量的限制和条件图像和噪声相接的薄弱,往往会产生面临高频纹理的文物和不正确的结构. 这表明,双象流DiT框架在增强模型的表达能力方面发挥着根本作用。

blocks.en: LayeredRefAttention Module. Observing the visual contamination from background and environmental lighting, we further integrate the LayeredRefAttention into the “+ D-i-s” version, denoted as “+ D-i-s + LRA”, which effectively decouples the intrinsic appearance of the shoe from its surroundings. As illustrated in Tab. 2 and Fig. 6 , the model without LayeredRefAttention often fails to accurately reproduce the natural colors of the shoe where environmental lighting or shadows of product images are prominent, resulting in outputs that are mixed with environmental light or shadows. Additionally, mismatches with background patches in Attention can introduce colors confusion from the background content, such as slippers being contaminated by floor colors in Column 3 of Fig. 6 . In contrast, the one with "LRA" effectively avoids such color contamination, delivering superior try-on results.
blocks.zh: 分层引用 模块。 我们观察到背景和环境照明造成的视觉污染,进一步将分层反射法融入“+D-i-s”版本,即“+D-i-s + 上帝军”,这实际上使鞋的内在外观与周围环境脱钩。 如图2和图6所示,无分层RefAttention的模型往往无法准确再现在环境照明或产品图像阴影突出的地方的鞋的自然颜色,导致输出物被环境光或阴影所混合. 此外,与“注意”中的背景补丁不匹配可能会使背景内容出现色彩混淆,例如拖鞋被图6第3栏的地板颜色所污染。 相形之下,有"LRA"的能有效避免这种色彩污染,能提供上等的尝试结果.

blocks.en: To investigate the efficacy of simple background masking, we conducted an ablation study utilizing standard attention while removing the background from the product shoe images. Visually, this naive approach exacerbates color artifacts, particularly for highly saturated hues. We hypothesize that this occurs because removing the background discards crucial illumination cues embedded in the product image, which are essential for the model to infer the shoe’s intrinsic material properties and texture. Given that the training set contains inherent color variations between in-studio product shots and on-foot images due to disparate lighting, forcing the model to operate without background context introduces lighting ambiguity. Consequently, the model struggles to maintain color constancy, leading to degraded try-on performance and reduced visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: 为了调查简单的背景遮掩的功效,我们利用标准关注,同时从产品鞋相中去除背景,进行了消化研究. 从视觉上看,这种天真的方法加剧了色彩文物,特别是对于高度饱和的花胡. 我们假设,之所以发生这种情况,是因为删除背景会丢弃嵌入产品图像中的关键发光提示,这对于模型推断出鞋的内在物质特性和纹理是必不可少的。 由于训练集中包含由不同照明而导致的上下行产品镜头和上行图像之间的内在颜色差异,迫使该模型在没有背景背景的情况下运行,从而引发了照明模糊. 因此,模型在保持色彩恒定性上挣扎,导致尝试性能退化并降低视觉忠心.

blocks.en: Multi-view Conditioning System. While a single source product view often fails to capture the complete texture of footwear, try-on results can benefit from multiple source views, thereby effectively reducing uncertainty in generation. Thus, we introduce the Multi-view Conditioning pipeline using Reference Concatenation and 3D RoPE in the “+ D-i-s + LRA” version, denoted as “+ D-i-s + LRA + MC”. As demonstrated in Tab. 2 and Fig. 6 , the model without “MC”, which uses only one product shoe image as input (yellow box), often generates unrealistic speculations and artifacts in unseen areas due to insufficient conditional information. In contrast, ShoeFit benefits from the Multi-view Conditioning system, producing details that are more faithful to the input across different views. Furthermore, we also conduct an ablation study upon 3D RoPE’s impact in Tab. 2 , demonstrating the performance gain we achieve using the proposed RoPE without incurring any additional computational overhead. Please refer to the Appendix for more ablation results.
blocks.zh: 多景条件体系. 虽然单一源产品视图往往无法捕捉到鞋类的完整纹理,但尝试结果可以从多个源视图中受益,从而有效减少生成中的不确定性. 因此,我们在“+D-i-s + 上帝军”版本中采用“参考聚合”和3D RoPE的多视图条件管道,表示“+D-i-s + 上帝军+MC”。 如Tab. 2和图6所示,没有“MC”的模型仅使用一种产品鞋相片作为输入(黄盒),由于条件信息不足,往往在看不见的地区产生不切实际的猜测和文物。 相形之下,ShoeFit从多景条件系统中获益,产生的细节更忠实于不同观点的投入. 此外,我们还对Tab的3D RoPE的影响进行了消化研究。 2,显示我们使用拟议的RoPE实现的性能收益,而不会引起任何额外的计算间接费用. 欲了解更多衰竭结果,请参见附录.

blocks.en: We evaluated the efficiency of our proposed enhancements by measuring inference time and memory footprint on an NVIDIA H20 GPU (with batch size of 1, 25 steps, and torch.bfloat16 precision). The results, presented in Table 3 , reveal that the ShoeFit model with our Dual-image-stream (D-i-s) architecture substantially outperforms CAT-VTON in both speed and memory efficiency. This stems from removing the text stream and its computationally expensive T5 and CLIP encoders.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In conclusion, we formally define the VFTON problem and curate the first shoe try-on dataset, MVShoes, containing 7305 pairs of high-quality multi-view garment-model samples. Our proposed framework addresses the critical challenges of viewpoint misalignment and background-induced color distortion by leveraging a dual-stream architecture with Multi-View Conditioning and LayeredRefAttention modules. Through a comprehensive evaluation on the proposed MVShoes dataset, we demonstrate significant improvements in detail fidelity and texture consistency across diverse scenarios. This indicates that our method effectively mitigates background interference while preserving fine-grained shoe details across views, establishing a strong baseline for future VFTON research.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们正式定义了VFTON问题,并整理了第一个鞋试装数据集"MVShoes",包含7305对高品质多景多景服装模型样本. 我们拟议的框架通过利用具有多维条件和分层反射模块的双流结构,解决观点错位和背景所引发的色彩扭曲的关键挑战。 通过对提议的MVShoes数据集进行综合评价,我们表明,在各种设想中,在详细忠实性和纹理一致性方面有重大改进。 这表明,我们的方法有效地减轻了背景干扰,同时保留了各种观点的精细的鞋类细节,为今后的VFTON研究确定了一个强有力的基线.

blocks.en: Broader impacts. With the ability to synthesize images, arises the risk that ShoeFit might be used for inappropriate purposes such as producing media that breaches intellectual property rights or privacy norms. Because of these risks, we strongly advocate for the conscientious use of this technology.
blocks.zh: 更大的影响。 有了合成图像的能力,ShoeFit就有可能被用于不适当的目的,例如生产违反知识产权或隐私规范的媒体。 由于这些风险,我们强烈主张认真使用这一技术。

blocks.en: Limitation and future work. ShoeFit demonstrates substantial improvements in generating high-fidelity footwear try-on images across diverse scenes. However, certain limitations persist. Firstly, the model occasionally struggles with accurately rendering small logos and intricate text, particularly critical for e-commerce sellers. Secondly, we hope to introduce explicit 3D geometric and material priors in the future to achieve more robust multi-view representation and refined visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 鞋Fit显示,在制作不同场景的高真实度鞋鞋试拍图像方面,有了很大的改进。 然而,某些限制依然存在。 首先,该模式有时难以准确制作小标志和复杂文本,特别是对电子商务销售商至关重要。 第二,我们希望今后引入明确的三维几何和材料前身,以实现更强的多观点表述和精细的视觉忠诚.

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We propose ShoeFit, a dual-stream DiT framework that addresses the critical challenges of viewpoint misalignment and background-induced color distortion in VFTON by Multi-View Conditioning and LayeredRefAttention modules.
However, certain limitations persist. Firstly, similar to the common constraints faced by existing generative models, the model occasionally struggles to accurately render small logos and intricate text due to their small portion in images and high-frequency variations. We illustrate this limitation in Fig. 7 . These small logos are particularly critical for e-commerce sellers as they often convey brand information that consumers care about. Therefore, we plan to develop a detailed supplementary conditioning method in future research to pre-detect and enhance the injection of such patterns, fundamentally addressing this issue. Secondly, we aim to introduce explicit 3D geometric and material priors in the future to achieve more robust multi-view representation and refined visual fidelity.
blocks.zh:
我们提出ShoeFit,这是一个双流的DiT框架,用以应对VFTON中由多View条件和分层RefAtention模块导致的观点错位和背景所引发的色彩扭曲的关键挑战.
然而,某些限制依然存在。 首先,与现有基因模型面临的共同制约相类似,该模型偶尔会因在图像中的小部分和高频变化而难以准确制作出小的标志和复杂文本. 我们在图7中说明了这一局限性。 这些小标志对电子商务销售商特别重要,因为它们经常传递消费者所关心的品牌信息. 因此,我们计划在今后的研究中制定详细的补充条件方法,预先发现和加强这种模式的注入,从根本上解决这一问题。 第二,我们的目标是在今后引入明确的三维几何和材料前身,以实现更强健的多观点表述和精细的视觉忠诚。

blocks.en: In the main body of the paper, we provide a brief description of the data processing pipeline and a rough visual presentation of the dataset statistics in terms of Rich Scenes and Diverse Footwear Categories due to space constraints. In this section, we offer more detailed information on the data processing pipeline to ensure reader comprehension. Additionally, we present the specific distribution statistics of MVShoes in a quantitative table format.
blocks.zh: 在文件正文中,我们简要地描述了数据处理管道,并粗略地直观地介绍了由于空间限制而按Rich Scens和Diversion Footwear 分类列出的数据集统计数据。 在本节中,我们提供关于数据处理流程的更详细资料,以确保读者理解。 此外,我们以定量表格格式提出MVShoes的具体分布统计数据。

blocks.en: Given a dataset comprising raw images of various shoes and human models, we employ Qwen2.5-VL [ 3 ] , which operates with 7 billion parameters, to distinguish between footwear images and human model images. The prompting framework utilized is as follows: “Analyze the provided image and determine whether it depicts a model image or a shoe image. A model image is defined as one that portrays a human model’s lower body or legs adorned with shoes, while a shoe image solely comprises images of shoes without any human presence. Assign a value of ‘1’ if it qualifies as a model image and ‘0’ if it does not. ”

blocks.en: Following this classification, we extract image features from the shoe images using the CLIP [ 53 ] model, implementing a similarity threshold of 0.9 to effectively eliminate duplicate images within the dataset. Subsequently, we perform segmentation by SAM [ 34 ] to isolate the shoe regions in each image, aligning the DINO [ 49 ] features to filter out shoes-model data pairs exhibiting inner similarities greater than 0.8.

blocks.en: Traditional open-source pose estimation methods (e.g., OpenPose, DWPose) in VITON pipeline, struggle to capture lower-body/foot poses in VFTON, which often only include partial leg shots or full lower-body views. To address this, we fine-tune the dwpose model on specially collected datasets containing diverse lower-body and close-up leg poses. This enables our model to generate accurate pose descriptions for various leg postures, significantly enhancing its generalization capability for shoe-related applications.
blocks.zh: 传统的开源在VITON管道中提出估计方法(如:OpenPose,DWPose),在VFTON中挣扎捕捉出下体/脚的姿势,这往往只包括部分腿部镜头或全身下体视图. 为了解决这个问题,我们对专门收集的包含不同下体和特写腿姿势的数据集上的dwpose模型进行了微调. 这使得我们的模型能够生成对各种腿姿势的准确的姿势描述,大大提高了它对鞋类应用的通俗化能力.

blocks.en: Given the diversity of shoe types (e.g., sneakers, boots, sandals) and their varying leg coverage, we propose a leg-pose-aware mask generation strategy. Unlike VTON’s body-centric masks, our method combines leg pose information with bounding box expansion from shoe detection to create adaptive masks. This allows seamless cross-shoe category try-on capabilities, for example, a model wearing long boots or flip-flops can be transformed into sneakers while maintaining anatomical alignment and realistic occlusion. As illustrated in the first row in Fig. 11 , this approach lays the foundation for robust, universal shoe try-on systems.
blocks.zh: 鉴于鞋类(如运动鞋,靴子,凉鞋等)的多样性及其不同腿部覆盖度,我们提议了一种有腿感面具生成策略. 与VTON的以身体为中心的口罩不同,我们的方法结合了腿来呈现信息,与从鞋检到产生适应性口罩的边框扩张相配合. 这允许无缝跨鞋类的试接能力,例如穿长靴或翻花的模型可以被转化成运动鞋,同时保持解剖对接和现实的隔离. 如图11第一行所示,这种方法为强有力的、普遍的鞋试验系统奠定了基础。

blocks.en: However, our mask generation strategy is not without its limitations. A failure case is presented in the second row of Fig. 5 (b). Here, the region of the rear shoe is both heavily occluded and minimally visible, which leads to the failure of our keypoint and shoe detection modules. Consequently, this rear shoe area is erroneously classified as background, and only the front foot is designated as the inpainting region. This incomplete mask ultimately results in an unsuccessful virtual try-on. We contend that this is an inherent challenge for all methods reliant on an explicit masking strategy, and developing more robust solutions to handle such severe occlusion cases remains an important direction for our future work.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的面具生成战略并非没有其局限性。 图5(b)第二行列出一个失败案例。 在这里,后鞋的区域既被严重占用也很少可见,这导致了我们的关键点和鞋检模块的失败. 因此,这一后鞋区被错误地归类为背景,只有前脚被指定为印花区. 这种不完整的面具最终导致虚拟尝试失败. 我们争辩说,对于所有依靠明确的掩盖战略的方法来说,这是固有的挑战,制定更强有力的解决办法来处理这种严重的隔离案件,仍然是我们今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: The volumetric expansion of footwear observed during the try-on process is a naturally occurring phenomenon. In real-world datasets, it is common to find that shoes with stiffer tongues tend to bulge outwards when worn, resulting in a slight expansion of the shoe’s overall volume. This effect is illustrated in Fig. 5 , where the third column clearly shows a prominent bulge in the tongue area, leading to body expansion. This expansion occurs stochastically in real-world data pairs, as exemplified in the third row of Fig. 1 (a), where the shoe upper in the second column exhibits a slightly thicker contour. Consequently, by effectively fitting to the training data distribution, our model learns to replicate this real-world phenomenon, accurately rendering the corresponding deformations inherent to the try-on process.
blocks.zh: 试验过程中观察到的鞋类体积扩张是一种自然而然的现象。 在现实世界的数据集中,人们通常会发现,用更硬的舌头穿穿的鞋子往往会向外凸出,导致鞋的总体积略有膨胀. 图5说明了这种效果,其中第三列明显显示舌部区域有突出起伏,导致身体扩张. 这种扩张在现实世界的数据对子中以相去相去法出现,例如图一(a)的第三行,第二列的鞋上部显示出稍厚的轮廓. 因此,通过有效地适应培训数据的分配,我们的模型学会了复制这种现实世界的现象,准确地使试运行过程固有的相应变形。

blocks.en: D.1 Baseline Training Details

blocks.en: We here provide detailed descriptions of the training processes for the baseline models, focusing specifically on the training configurations. All models are trained on MVShoes at a resolution of 768 × 768 768\times 768 , utilizing 6305 pairs for training and 1000 pairs for testing.
blocks.zh: 我们在此详细介绍了基线模型的培训过程,具体侧重于培训配置。 所有型号均以768×768 768\times 768的分辨率进行MVShoes培训,使用6305对用于培训,1000对用于测试.

blocks.en: For Flux.1 Fill [ 6 ] , we implement the training and inference pipeline by concatenating footwear images with human model images. In the trainable components, we apply LoRA [ 26 ] with a rank of 64 to all attention modules in the model and a Flux ControlNet [ 71 ] comprising 6 single layers and 6 double layers, injecting the poses at every denoising step. The model is trained for 6 days on 8 80GB-A100 GPUs using DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, with a batch size of 4. We utilize the AdamW optimizer, setting a constant learning rate of 3e-5 for training, and operate the model on a single A100 GPU for 25 steps during inference.
blocks.zh: 对于Flux 1 填 [6],我们通过将鞋类图像与人类模型图像相接来实施培训和推论管道. 在可训练组件中,我们采用LORA[26],在模型中的所有注意模块中排出64等分,以及由6个单层和6个双层组成的Flux ControlNet[71],在每一个去诺步骤上注入平面. 该型号在使用DeepSpeed ZeRO-2的8台80GB-A100GPU上被训练了6天,分批尺寸为4. 我们利用AdamW优化器,设定3e-5的常年学习率用于训练,并在推论中为25个步骤在单A100GPU上操作模型.

blocks.en: For Flux.1 Redux [ 7 ] , we adopt the same training settings as those used for FLUX.1-Fill. Additionally, we incorporate two linear layers for projecting SigLip [ 70 ] features of the product shoe images, training these two layers concurrently with the attention LoRAs and ControlNet. The parameters of SigLip remain frozen throughout the training process. We retain the same inference settings as employed in FLUX.1-Fill.
blocks.zh: 对于Flux.1 Redux [7],我们采用与FLUX.1-Fill相同的训练设置. 此外,我们纳入了两个线性层,用于投影SigLip[70]产品鞋相图的特性,培训这两层与注意力Loras和ControlNet同时进行。 在整个培训过程中,西格利普的参数一直被冻结. 我们保留了与FLUX.1-Fill中使用的相同的推论设置.

blocks.en: For OOTDiffusion [ 65 ] , we execute the training and inference pipelines based on the official code. We also implement ControlNet to facilitate pose injection. The model is trained for 6 days on 4 80GB-A100 GPUs with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, at a batch size of 8. During inference, the model is run on a single A10 GPU for 25 steps.

blocks.en: D.2 Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: D.2 数据增强

blocks.en: We have implemented data augmentation techniques that could potentially enhance the model’s generalization ability as well as its fidelity performance. Specifically, the data augmentation operations include (a) horizontal flipping of images, (b) resizing footwear and human figures through padding (up to 10% of the image size), (c) randomly adjusting the image’s hue within a range of -5 to +5, and (d) randomly adjusting the image’s contrast within a specified range (between 0.8 and 1.2 times the original contrast). Each of these operations occurs independently with a 50% probability. Moreover, these operations are simultaneously applied to both the footwear and model images.
blocks.zh: 我们实施了数据扩增技术,这些技术有可能增强模型的通缩能力及其忠实性能。 具体来说,数据增强操作包括(a) 图像的横向翻转,(b) 通过加码(高达图像大小的10%)调整鞋类和人的数字,(c) 在-5到+5的范围内随机调整图像的花色,(d) 在指定范围内随机调整图像的对比度(0.8到1.2倍的原始对比度). 每项操作都以50%的概率独立进行. 此外,这些操作同时适用于鞋和模型图像。
